name: biceps-curl-dumbbell-incline
title: Biceps Curl: Dumbbell (Incline)
primer: This exercise uses an incline bench to change your body's position as you perform Biceps Curls.
steps: Adjust an incline bench to a 45 degree angle.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand and sit down with your back against the bench, with your feet resting on the floor for support.
Allow your arms to hang down at your sides.
Keeping your elbows still, raise the dumbbells up towards your head, contracting your biceps.
In a controlled manner lower the weight and repeat.
tips: The movement is very similar to a Preacher Curl.
Practise steady movements in this exercise, and be careful not to let your arms sway.
